In Sales Performance and Executive Overview, seven tiles cut the title to 35–61 px of 78–134 px of text, because the measure label sat beside it with shrink-0. One new module, packages/plugin-dashboard/src/metricTile.ts, now holds the layout rule. The title owns the first line (13 px / 500, line-clamp-2). The value never wraps (whitespace-nowrap) and is text-xl below a 160 px tile, @[160px]:text-2xl from there up. The measure label is an 11 px muted line under the value, hidden below 160 px and appended to the title's tooltip. All of it is keyed off @container on the tile, never the viewport. DatasetWidget (dataset-bound), MetricWidget (plain; also ObjectMetricWidget and every object-metric page block, including HotCRM Sales Home's four KPIs) and MetricCard all read it. Mechanism assumption 1 confirmed. Assumption 2 is false: there were three separate headers (MetricCard's CardTitle, MetricWidget's CardTitle, DatasetWidget's MetricHeadingRow), and per the ruling they now share the one module rather than being fixed three times. Browser readings: at 1024 px every title is complete and every value fits on one line at 20 px with no label. At 1280 px, and in a tile forced to 240 px, the label shows at 11 px.
